ly_do_phan_xu: KHONG co mot co che RUNTIME chung. Sau thuc the tieu SAU tai nguyen KHAC NHAU truoc cong: dong RNG dung chung (D-M3-20), tran capacity cua o (B2), ngan sach CHU Y cua tai xe (M4), so lan can suc khoe (M1), so mau-so cua audit (M2), va mot hang store append-only o trang thai hap thu (M3, M5). Khong co object nao ma ca sau cung cham vao, nen mot assertion runtime khong the phu het — day la ly do KHONG co mot cong duy nhat cho ca lop. NHUNG chung KHONG chi la cach ke chuyen gon: chung chia se mot DAU HIEU QUAN SAT DUOC va chung mot huong sai — moi cai deu tao ra mot BAT DOI XUNG SO SACH: dem 'X da xay ra' > dem 'X co tac dung', va phan chenh KHONG DUOC KHAI o dau ca. Ba trong sau (M1, M2, B2) do duoc truc tiep bang chinh bat doi xung do ma KHONG can doc code (pattern P5). Va co mot bang chung manh rang do la CAU TRUC chu khong phai trung hop: repo da tu tim ra khuon nay hai lan doc lap va dat ten cho no — R-08 ('cong khong-co-gi-de-noi dung TRUOC cadence/coin', sua 5 kenh) va L1-04 ('`_claim_effect` phai dung SAU clamp kha thi', do duoc 38/135 = 28% quyet dinh bien mat). M4 va M5 la DUNG hai luat do bi vi pham o cho khac; M1/M2 la cung mot cong dat sai o hai kenh anh em, sai NGUOC CHIEU NHAU. Mot khuon duoc phat hien lai bon lan boc lap la cau truc, khong phai cach ke chuyen. => MOT_PHAN: co that o tang DAU HIEU va o tang LUAT DA THANH VAN cua repo, khong co that o tang co che runtime.

cong_chan_tai_dien.ten: test_kenh_TAT_khong_de_lai_dau_vet — arm DOI CHUNG phai SACH, doi voi TUNG kenh
cong_chan_tai_dien.phat_bieu: Voi moi kenh c thuoc {shift_plan, accept_lift, shift_extend, rest_window, swap_early, station_choice, positioning}: (a) chay `run_once(_cfg_with(cfg, enabled=False, actor_id=None, channels=None), SEED_GHIM)` va assert so event mang `detail['channel'] == c` BANG 0; (b) chay `run_once` voi DUY NHAT kenh c bat va assert so event mang `channel == c` LON HON 0. Ve (b) la de cong khong the xanh bang cach kenh khong bao gio ghi gi (chong test-ghim-vo-hieu — dung ho L2 ma vong nay vua liet ke).
cong_chan_tai_dien.trang_thai_hom_nay: DO cho `rest_window` (arm doi chung sinh 125/107/118 event mang channel=rest_window tren seed 5000/5001/5002; ve (b) cung DO vi kenh sinh 0 event `advice_rest_window` — no dang TRO). XANH cho 6 kenh con lai (arm doi chung sinh dung 0 event mang channel cua chung).
cong_chan_tai_dien.chi_phi: 2 lan `run_once` cho ve (a) + 1 lan/kenh cho ve (b). `run_once` do duoc 5,8s tren may nay. Ve (a) la 1 run cho CA 7 kenh (dem mot lan, assert 7 lan) => ~6s. Ve (b) la 7 run => ~40s; co the ghim 1 seed va danh dau slow. Repo da co tien le chay sim trong test (`tests/test_rest_rails_guardrail.py`).

vi_sao_cong_kha_thi: KHONG PHAI 'nhac moi nguoi can than hon' — no la mot assertion so hoc tren event log, chay duoc, khong can nguoi doc code.
EXACT, khong thong ke: khong CI, khong tolerance, khong bootstrap => khong flaky => khong bi ai tat vi nhieu. Day la ly do toi chon no thay vi cong 'hoa so TIEU vs GIAO' (xem phan phan bien duoi).
DO NGAY HOM NAY tren ma nguon hien tai (125 event) => KHONG VACUOUS. Mot cong moc ma xanh ngay tu dau la cong chua chung minh duoc gi.

Khong the lam xanh bang cach khai bao: khong co registry de nhet vao. Muon xanh phai HOAC dua cong kenh len dau `should_defer_rest`, HOAC loc reason o cho log giong `world.py:905`. Ca hai deu la sua dung root cause.
Phu duoc ca kenh TUONG LAI: bat ky ai them kenh moi ma de no cham vao the gioi khi tat se DO ngay, khong can ai nho luat.

No la ban CHAY DUOC cua mot bai hoc da co trong memory cua du an ('Arm doi chung phai SACH' — loi that DET-01, da tung bao so sai cho Cuong). Bien mot bai hoc thanh mot assertion la dung viec cua mot cong.

phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.phuong_an_da_can_nhac: Cong 'HOA SO': voi moi kenh, assert `so lan TIEU (tran/ngan sach/RNG/ghi so) == so lan loi khuyen THAT SU toi tay tai xe`, phan chenh phai khai o mot registry kem SO DO + dieu kien mo lai (khuon `RAIL_KHAI_TRO`).
phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.vi_sao_KHONG_chon: Phu rong hon (bat duoc CA B2 lan M4 lan M1), nhung: (1) cac so la NGAU NHIEN theo seed (coin_true 33/43/39 tren 3 seed) => phai ghim seed + dai dung sai => co nguy co flaky => co nguy co bi tat, dung so phan ma vong truoc canh bao; (2) no doi mot bo dem 'da tieu' MOI o tung call-site — ai them call-site ma quen dem thi cong MU, tuc chinh no lai la mot co che 'song tren giay'; (3) `RAIL_KHAI_TRO` hom nay chi chua CHUOI, khong chua so, nen registry kieu do da chung minh la de bien thanh con dau cao su — va do duoc: no dang bao ve `veto_soc_low_n` trong khi chinh `veto_calls_n` (mau so cua no) da bi o nhiem (M1). GHI LAI de nguoi sau muon lam thi phai sua ca ba diem tren truoc.
phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.de_xuat: Neu sau nay van muon, hay lam no thanh mot SCRIPT DO (`scripts/`) co prereg, khong phai mot test trong `pytest -q`.

phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.phuong_an_da_can_nhac: Cong 'ly do TAM THOI khong duoc sinh trang thai HAP THU': liet ke moi reason_code ma `cadence.evaluate` + `evaluate_checkpoint` co the sinh, bat buoc phan loai TRANSIENT/PERMANENT trong mot registry (fail-closed nhu `advice_topics.classify`), roi assert reason TRANSIENT khong dan toi trang thai co `_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[state] == frozenset()`.
phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.danh_gia: Day la cong DUNG cho M3 va chi cho M3 — no re (~ms), fail-closed, khong flaky, va DO ngay hom nay (`topic_cooldown` va `shift_budget_exhausted` deu TAM THOI ma dan toi `suppressed` hap thu). Toi de xuat no nhu cong THU HAI, doc lap, chi cho nua san pham. Toi KHONG gop no vao cong chinh vi gop hai assertion khac ban chat vao mot test lam ca hai kho doc va de bi skip ca cum.
phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.trang_thai: DE XUAT PHU — chua do chi phi, chua viet

phan_bien_CACH_SUA_cua_chinh_toi.canh_bao_that: KHONG co cong nao trong hai cai tren bat duoc B2 (kenh DANG SHIP) va M4. Ly do da noi o `ly_do_phan_xu`: chung tieu tai nguyen khac. Toi noi thang dieu do thay vi mo rong cong cho co ve phu het.

cai_chua_kiem: M1/M2: chua do tren 30 seed. Cac so 125/107/118 va 3204/3270/3742 la 3 seed; DAU HIEU (khac 0 / bang nhau) la cau truc nen khong doi theo seed, nhung DO LON thi chua co CI.
M1: chua truy xem con so `veto_*` da bi o nhiem nay DA vao artifact/ban bao cao nao chua (toi chi chung minh no o nhiem, chua chung minh no da lam ai ket luan sai).
M2: chua kiem `run_pair_multiday` — no nhan `channels_a` tuy y, nen ve ly thuyet co the co caller truyen shift_extend vao arm A va lam guard song lai. Chua grep het caller.

M3: chua kiem duong `routers/advice_v2.py` end-to-end qua HTTP (toi goi thang `AdviceCheckpointService`). Chua kiem `dismissed_for_window` (nghi la con nang hon vi ten no HUA la 'theo cua so' nhung `_cadence_memory` v2 khong co cua so nao).

M5: chua do nhanh tai xe CO duoc phu (`d-`/`r-`) — tren dataset mock nay `advisor.advice()` luon co card cho ho (0/10670 lan im), nen ty le MA cho nhom do la ~0 HOM NAY. Ma phat sinh tu nhom KHONG duoc phu (26,7% cohort) va tu nhanh `is_driving`.

Cong de xuat: chua viet thanh test that, chua do thoi gian ve (b) tren may CI, chua kiem lieu co kenh nao co LY DO CHINH DANG de cham vao arm tat (neu co thi cong can mot registry — va luc do no thua huong dung nhuoc diem cua phuong an 'hoa so' ma toi vua bac).
Toan bo so lieu tren la MOCK (`configs/pilot_dongda.yaml`, `data_mode: synthetic` / `mock-realdata`), khong phai so that cua GSM.
